name: truthwatcher
description: Surgebinders who command Progression and Illumination. Truthwatchers are quiet observers and careful healers, guided by insight few others can see. They seek knowledge not to control, but to protect.

ideals.label: first ideal
ideals.description: The universal Ideal shared by all Radiants. A pledge to value life, seek strength for the right reasons, and walk a path of purpose over outcome.
quotes: Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before destination.

ideals.label: second ideal
ideals.description: The Truthwatcher begins to accept the burden of knowledge — and the obligation to use it carefully.
quotes: I will speak the truth I see, even when others will not listen.

ideals.label: third ideal
ideals.description: They swear to protect truth and life alike, healing what they can, revealing only what must be known.
quotes: I will guard truth like a flame in the dark.
What I know, I will use to protect.

ideals.label: fourth ideal
ideals.description: The Truthwatcher accepts that truth is not always kind — but still must be faced, shared, and sometimes hidden with wisdom.
quotes: I will not flinch from what must be known.

ideals.label: fifth ideal
ideals.description: They become a vessel of revelation — guiding others not with force, but through healing, light, and clarity.
quotes: I am truth, and in truth, I protect.
